trap-negation-contrast.notes: FIVE FINDINGS. (1) c_5 CONTRADICTS ITS OWN PROPOSITION -- see the verdict on prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder. The proposition needs correcting, not this remark. (2) STALE c_3 VALUE: 'c_3: -2.010 at the muon-pin q_0, -2.069 at the m_p-pin q_0'. Per AGENTS.md the muon-pin c_3 is -2.02020024; -2.0097 is the SUPERSEDED pre-#1422 value that -2.010 rounds to. The stale pair implies a cross-anchor swing of 2.85 percent, whereas the current pair gives 2.37478 percent. AGENTS.md flags this exact stale figure as the source of the corpus's '2.98%/2.88%' numbers. (3) SWEEP DAMAGE, three sites: the section heading 'canonical precision ladder' (read: 'Numerical precision ladder'), 'Verified at q_0 via the canonical formalism at 50 dps', and 'From the canonical formalism:' before the epsilon_DeltaS formula. All three are the documented token substitution where a script name belonged; I could not recover the names, so none was fixed. (4) PIN CURRENCY vs THE LIVE DASHBOARD: the block claims the N=3 rung beats the 7.80 ppb target and that N>=4 reaches sub-ppb on Q_beta. (5) CONVENTION C, as for the proposition: the ladder is C-frame throughout via z in alpha, already scoped corpus-wide by bean qou-cds1.
